dr_wav.h, dr_mp3.h and dr_flac.h come from https://github.com/mackron/dr_libs

Single-header decoders, public domain or MIT-0 at your choice (the licence is at the foot of each
header). Vendored rather than fetched at configure time because dr_libs has no tagged releases, so
there is no URL with a hash that stays valid.

They are compiled once in standalone/AudioFile.cpp, which is the only place that defines the
DR_..._IMPLEMENTATION macros.
